---
type: parens
title: 'Make $10 - 4 - 2$ equal $8$'
expression: 10 − 4 − 2
target: "8"
---

Tap a gap to place **(**, then a gap to its right to place **)**. Put one pair of parentheses in so that it equals $8$.

## Hint
Without parentheses, subtraction goes left to right: $10 - 4 - 2 = 6 - 2 = 4$. What if the second subtraction were done first?

## Solution
**Answer:** $10 - (4 - 2)$

Parentheses are done first: $10 - (4 - 2) = 10 - 2 = 8$.
